notes.title: Chaos of Destiny Remake - Chapter 4
notes.notes: [p]That's right![/p][p][b][i]<Chapter 3: The Plague>[/i][/b] is now fully completed, and we're headed off to give our adventure a solid Chapter 4 and the start of the long-awaited [b][i]Early Access[/i][/b].[/p][p]So, stay tuned for the next few days, [b][i]because this is about to kick off![/i][/b][/p]

notes.title: CODR - CHAPTER 3: On the Way to Early Access
notes.notes: [p]We're working very hard to give our players an adventure worthy of remembrance.[/p][p][/p][p]We're pleased to announce that [b]< Chapter 3: The Plague >[/b] is almost complete.[/p][p][/p][p]We'd also like to take this opportunity to announce the upcoming [b]Early Access[/b], which [b][u]will include a 20% discount[/u][/b] on the game and will be [b][u]playable starting with the fourth chapter[/u][/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Please note that playing a video game that is [b]still in development[/b] may [b]contain errors or bugs[/b], and a [b]subsequent update may make previous saves incompatible[/b].[/p][p]Therefore, given the complexity of playing a video game in development, we're offering a [b]discount to all players[/b] who want to [b]venture into ChaosWorld early[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]What will Early Access include?[/u][/b] Early Access will begin when Chapter 4 is fully completed, ensuring you've already had several hours of solid story and gameplay from the start. From there, we'll release free updates for all owners, adding new chapters, improvements, and content until the entire adventure is complete.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Join us![/u][/b] By purchasing the game in Early Access, you'll not only enjoy a special price, but you'll also be part of ChaosWorld's growth, helping us shape it with your feedback and build something unique together. Thank you for believing in this project and being part of the story from the beginning![/p][p][/p][p][i]We made the decision to open Early Access with the goal of receiving support and starting to build a community; With this in mind, we encourage you to contact our team if you encounter any issues during your games.[/i][/p]

notes.title: Demo Review (Patch)
notes.notes:
We've added a number of changes and updates to the game to polish details so our players can enjoy a demo worthy of its title and free of errors.

We welcome any feedback if you find any errors!

Once the demo is complete, we'll begin developing the next chapters of Chaos of Destiny Remake.

notes.title: CODR DEMO now available!
notes.notes:
After weeks and weeks of development and design, the official game demo is now available for players around the world to experience.
What are you waiting for to dive into ChaosWorld?
You can find it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3535300/Chaos_of_Destiny_Remake_Demo/

notes.title: UPDATE: CHAPTER 2 ¡COMPLETED!
notes.notes:
This is great news, as Chapter 2 of Chaos of Destiny: Remake is now fully realized. What does this mean? A playable demo will be available very soon and we will begin this grand adventure.
Keep your eyes peeled for upcoming updates and dive into ChaosWorld!

notes.title: WHAT'S NEW: CHAPTER 1 COMPLETED!
notes.notes:
COD-R CH 1 is now a reality!
At Klayerama we know that effort and dedication are very important for a team, and we are pleased to announce that Chapter 1 of the game is now fully designed and finished.

"We want the game to be totally worthwhile," so we work day in and day out to make it an unforgettable and engaging experience.
